- Police violence and named cases: calls not to let Mario Woods's death go unnoticed, including a shared video of the SFPD shooting [T4-009350](#T4-009350) [T4-009343](#T4-009343); a two-year remembrance of 12-year-old Tamir Rice [T4-004975](#T4-004975); a hashtag cluster referencing the Falcon Heights shooting, Philando Castile and Alton Sterling [T4-002710](#T4-002710); and criticism that Donald Trump mentioned Hillary's emails but not police killings of Black people [T4-002725](#T4-002725).
- Commentary and opinion: shock at opposition to the hashtag [T4-009366](#T4-009366); a claim that Idris Elba sees a "feeling of uprising" in the UK after US police brutality [T4-009392](#T4-009392); a reminder that Beyoncé is "woke" [T4-009384](#T4-009384); a nostalgia post attacking rap-era division [T4-009288](#T4-009288); a "check facts" post tagged with police-brutality hashtags [T4-009247](#T4-009247); and a post contrasting "Black Rifles Matter" with the hashtag [T4-003436](#T4-003436).
- Hostile or dismissive posts: one calling the events "disgusting" [T4-009393](#T4-009393), one blaming "Soros/Hillary professional RIOTERS" [T4-009417](#T4-009417), and one claiming a fact makes protest membership "zero" [T4-009414](#T4-009414).
- Culture/humor and other: a joke about being the only Black kid in school [T4-009246](#T4-009246), a poetry post [T4-009272](#T4-009272), and a short post tagging Paul O'Neal and BLM Chicago [T4-009379](#T4-009379).
